strategies.summary: Use 1-hour intermediate-term structure to set the presenter's draw on liquidity, wait for price to trade into a 1-hour PD array during the presenter's New York AM or PM equity-session windows, and then enter from a lower-timeframe fair value gap. On 1m the presenter wants the second same-direction gap; on 5m one touched same-direction gap is sufficient.

timeframes.notes: The 1h chart sets the presenter's draw-on-liquidity context and the 1h PD array; execution is on 1m or 5m. This is the presenter's directional read, not the engine BOS/CHoCH structure bias.

glossary.8:30/9:30 rule: If the 08:30 equity-session move already reaches the 1h PD array and displaces from it, the presenter expects the 09:30 open to continue that work rather than engineer a fresh sweep.
glossary.1-minute entry pattern: Uses custom_signals.two_consecutive_fvgs: wait for the second same-direction 1m fair value gap before taking the retracement entry.
glossary.5-minute entry pattern: On 5m, one touched same-direction fair value gap after the 1h array tap is enough; if the first gap never retraces, the next valid 5m gap can be used.

custom_signals.name: htf_pd_array_tap
custom_signals.plain_definition: Price trades into a higher-timeframe discount array (bullish) or premium array (bearish), such as a fair value gap or order block.
custom_signals.numeric_definition: (low <= bullish_fvg[0].gap_high@bias_tf AND high >= bullish_fvg[0].gap_low@bias_tf AND NOT bullish_fvg[0].filled@bias_tf) OR (low <= bullish_ob[0].zone_high@bias_tf AND high >= bullish_ob[0].zone_low@bias_tf AND NOT bullish_ob[0].invalidated@bias_tf)

custom_signals.name: arjoio_ny_am_session
custom_signals.plain_definition: The presenter's New York AM session: 08:30 to 11:00 New York time.

custom_signals.name: arjoio_ny_pm_session
custom_signals.plain_definition: The presenter's New York PM session: 13:30 to 16:00 New York time.

custom_signals.name: fvg_touched
custom_signals.plain_definition: Price trades into the fair value gap (a touch or sting), without requiring the consequent encroachment.

custom_signals.name: intermediate_term_high
custom_signals.plain_definition: A swing high flanked by a lower swing high on its left and a lower swing high on its right.

custom_signals.name: intermediate_term_low
custom_signals.plain_definition: A swing low flanked by a higher swing low on its left and a higher swing low on its right.

custom_signals.name: short_term_low
custom_signals.plain_definition: A standard swing low (three-candle rule) that is not an intermediate term low.

sequence: Use 1h intermediate-term structure to frame the presenter's draw on liquidity and wait for price to tap the 1h PD array.
Only work inside the presenter's New York AM or PM equity-session windows, not London.
On 1m require the second same-direction fair value gap; on 5m one touched same-direction fair value gap is enough.
Enter on the retracement into that lower-timeframe gap and aim for the opposing 1h intermediate-term swing.

invalidation.text: If the 1-hour intermediate term structure high/low is violated, the setup and bias are invalidated.

filters.text: Do not trade London session for US indices like ES, NQ, or YM; wait for New York sessions.
Choose either the 1-minute or 5-minute entry model and stick to it; do not use both simultaneously.

entry_rule.text: After the 1h PD-array tap, enter on the retracement into the lower-timeframe bullish fair value gap that qualifies the chosen entry model.
entry_rule.quote: once you have that second fair value Gap lower that is exactly when you want to get involved

target_rule.text: Target the opposing 1h intermediate-term high / premium-array objective.
target_rule.quote: the obvious draw on liquidity is what it's this low right it's that intermediate term low that is our first Target

stop_rule.text: Place the stop beyond the short-term low that forms the lower-timeframe entry swing.
stop_rule.quote: what do you cover you can cover that high why that high that is a shortterm high that should hold

management.breakeven: Move to breakeven based on structural displacements and short-term highs holding.

presenter_claims.claim: You can get a 1 to 2 Risk:Reward ratio in less than 10 minutes using the 1-minute entry pattern.

strategies.notes: Bias independent means no separate daily-bias filter is required; the working bias is the presenter's 1h draw-on-liquidity read. That presenter bias is not the engine BOS/CHoCH structure bias. The machine model encodes the 1h PD-array tap, the New York equity-session windows, the lower-timeframe gap touch, and the opposing 1h intermediate-term target, while the 8:30/9:30 sequencing rule and the choice between the 1m second-gap model and the 5m one-gap model remain partly descriptive.

A second 1-minute FVG forms lower; price retraces into it for the entry.
